Reads /proc status files and updates voluntary and involuntary context-switch metrics.

# Purpose
This file defines the `cswtch` tile, which reads Linux task status data from `/proc/<pid>/task/<tid>/status` and writes context switch counts into the metrics area for each tile. It tracks both `voluntary_ctxt_switches` and `nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches`, and it also handles tile death cases by stopping updates for tiles that are allowed to shut down or by delaying warning messages for tiles that are expected to be terminated by the supervisor.

The code is a tile implementation for the `fd_stem` runtime and `fd_topo` topology system. It provides the tile setup functions for privileged and unprivileged init, seccomp policy setup, allowed file descriptor setup, and the run entry point `fd_tile_cswtch`. The main loop uses [`before_credit`](<#before_credit>) to rate limit status checks to about every 100 ms, open and keep the needed `/proc` status file descriptors, and update the shared metrics counters for each tile.
